description: Defines health thresholds and automated responses for runtime conditions detected by the AI runtime agent.

healthy.description: All systems operating within normal parameters.

degraded.description: System operating below optimal thresholds. Generate recommendations but no automated actions.

unhealthy.description: System in critical state. Generate incident report with remediation actions.

deployment_integrity.message: Deployment integrity compromised — verify SHA256SUMS and RELEASE_MANIFEST
deployment_integrity.remediation: Re-deploy from verified release package or run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt

runtime_validity.message: Required folder structure incomplete — check deployment extraction
runtime_validity.remediation: Re-extract the release package or verify rsync/zip integrity

module_availability.message: Python module count critically low — possible incomplete deployment
module_availability.remediation: Re-deploy from release package and verify folder presence

json_validation.message: Required JSON outputs missing or invalid — data pipeline may be broken
json_validation.remediation: Re-run geometry/lattice/shoe generators and verify outputs

session_consistency.message: Deployment sessions report integrity failures — audit session history
session_consistency.remediation: Review session logs, re-deploy if corruption suspected
